title: The Network Society Revisited
notes: OpenAlex record year 2022 vs 2023 in the library entry (online-first vs print year); accepted on DOI and title match. OpenAlex lists only 1 referenced work, possibly sparse. | S2 reference list null (publisher elided)
abstract: The theory of the network society, in my own version, was originally elaborated in the book that, under the title The Rise of the Network Society, I published in 1996. It was revised and updated in the 2000 and 2010 editions. However, the significant social change that has taken place on a global scale in the last decade provides an opportunity to reassess its heuristic value. Therefore, in this text, I will attempt to consider the currency of the theory of the network society when confronted with these changes.
